lines.text: 숲속 통나무집에 곰 세 식구가 살았어요.
lines.en: A family of three bears lived in a log cabin in the woods.
segs: A family of three bears lived in a log cabin in the woods.

lines.en: Tap the bear family to say hello!
segs: Tap the bear family to say hello!

lines.en: Tap a bear and say hi!
segs: Tap a bear and say hi!

lines.text: 아빠 곰은 굵은 목소리, 아기 곰은 가느다란 목소리예요.
lines.en: Papa Bear has a deep voice, and Baby Bear has a tiny voice.
segs: Papa Bear has a deep voice, and Baby Bear has a tiny voice.

lines.text: 엄마 곰이 맛있는 죽을 끓였어요. 그런데 너무 뜨거워요!
lines.en: Mama Bear cooked some yummy porridge. But it's too hot!
segs: Mama Bear cooked some yummy porridge. But it's too hot!

lines.en: Tap, tap, and blow on it for me!
segs: Tap, tap, and blow on it for me!

lines.en: Tap the porridge and blow! Whoo!
segs: Tap the porridge and blow! Whoo!

lines.en: The steam is going down, but it's still hot.
segs: The steam is going down, but it's still hot.

lines.text: 아빠 곰: "죽이 식을 동안 산책 다녀오자!"
lines.en: Papa Bear: "Let's go for a walk while the porridge cools!"
segs: Let's go for a walk while the porridge cools!

lines.en: In the woods lived a girl with golden hair, named Goldilocks.
segs: In the woods lived a girl with golden hair, named Goldilocks.

lines.en: Tap, tap the screen and walk along with her!
segs: Tap, tap the screen and walk along with her!

lines.en: Tap, tap! Walk with Goldilocks.

lines.text: 꽃을 세 송이 땄어요. 어? 저기 통나무집이 있어요!
lines.en: She picked three flowers. Oh? Look, a log cabin!

lines.text: 우와, 커다란 문이에요. 문을 톡 두드려 봐요.
lines.en: Wow, what a big door! Give it a knock.
Tap the door! Knock, knock.
Goldilocks: "Hello? Is anyone home?"
There is no answer.

lines.text: 문이 삐걱 열렸어요. 골디락스가 살짝 들어가 봤어요.
lines.en: The door creaked open. Goldilocks tiptoed inside.
segs: The door creaked open. Goldilocks tiptoed inside.

lines.text: 식탁 위에 죽이 세 그릇 있어요.
lines.en: There are three bowls of porridge on the table.
segs: There are three bowls of porridge on the table.

lines.en: Which porridge is just right?
Hot, hot! It's way too hot!
segs: Hot, hot! It's way too hot!

lines.en: It's way too cold, like ice!
segs: It's way too cold, like ice!

lines.text: 김이 펄펄 나면 뜨겁고, 얼음이 있으면 차가워요.
lines.en: Porridge with lots of steam is hot, and porridge with ice is cold.
segs: Porridge with lots of steam is hot, and porridge with ice is cold.

lines.en: It's the small bowl with just a little steam!
segs: It's the small bowl with just a little steam!

lines.text: 딱 좋아요! 냠냠, 작은 그릇을 다 먹어 버렸어요.
lines.en: Just right! Yum, yum! She ate up the whole small bowl.
segs: She ate up the whole small bowl.

lines.en: Now there are three chairs.
Which chair is just right?
It's too high! Her legs dangle, dangle.
It's so squishy, she sank right in!
segs: It's so squishy, she sank right in!

lines.text: 너무 크지도, 너무 푹신하지도 않은 의자예요.
lines.en: It's the chair that's not too big and not too squishy.
segs: It's the chair that's not too big and not too squishy.

lines.en: It's the small chair! Tap the sparkling chair.
segs: It's the small chair! Tap the sparkling chair.

lines.en: Just right! But then...

lines.text: 뿌지직! 작은 의자가 부서져서 엉덩방아를 찧었어요.
lines.en: Crack! The little chair broke, and she plopped down on her bottom.
segs: Crack! The little chair broke, and she plopped down on her bottom.

lines.text: 하암, 졸려요. 위층에 침대가 세 개 있어요.
lines.en: Yaaawn, I'm sleepy. There are three beds upstairs.
Which bed is just right?
It's too hard!
It's too soft!
It's the bed that's not too hard and not too soft.
segs: It's the bed that's not too hard and not too soft.

lines.en: It's the small bed! Tap the sparkling bed.
segs: It's the small bed! Tap the sparkling bed.

lines.text: 딱 좋아요! 자장가를 들려줄게요. 잘 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Just right! Let's hear a lullaby. Listen closely.
segs: Let's hear a lullaby. Listen closely.

lines.text: 이번에는 침대를 톡 눌러 봐요. 자장가가 이어져요!
lines.en: This time, tap the bed. The lullaby keeps going!
segs: This time, tap the bed. The lullaby keeps going!

lines.en: Goldilocks fell fast asleep. Zzz.
Just then, the bear family came home from their walk.
segs: Just then, the bear family came home from their walk.

lines.en: Papa Bear: "Who ate my porridge?"
The bowls are all mixed up. Help find each bowl's owner!
segs: The bowls are all mixed up. Help find each bowl's owner!

lines.en: Whose is this big bowl?

lines.text: 큰 그릇은 가장 큰 곰 거예요.
lines.en: The big bowl belongs to the biggest bear.
segs: The big bowl belongs to the biggest bear.

lines.en: It's Papa Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
segs: It's Papa Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.

lines.en: Mama Bear: "My bowl is smaller~"
Baby Bear: "My bowl is smaller~"
Whose is this medium bowl?
The medium bowl belongs to the middle bear.
segs: The medium bowl belongs to the middle bear.

lines.en: It's Mama Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
segs: It's Mama Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.

lines.en: Papa Bear: "My bowl is bigger~"
Baby Bear: "My bowl is smaller~"
Whose is this small bowl?

lines.text: 작은 그릇은 가장 작은 곰 거예요.
lines.en: The small bowl belongs to the smallest bear.
segs: The small bowl belongs to the smallest bear.

lines.en: It's Baby Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
segs: It's Baby Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.

lines.en: Papa Bear: "My bowl is bigger~"
Mama Bear: "My bowl is bigger~"

lines.text: 아기 곰: "내 죽을 다 먹어 버렸어!"
lines.en: Baby Bear: "Someone ate up all my porridge!"
segs: Someone ate up all my porridge!

lines.en: Who could it have been?
Now help find whose chair is whose.
segs: Now help find whose chair is whose.

lines.en: Whose is this big chair?

lines.text: 큰 의자는 가장 큰 곰 거예요.
lines.en: The big chair belongs to the biggest bear.
segs: The big chair belongs to the biggest bear.

lines.en: It's Papa Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
segs: It's Papa Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.

lines.en: Mama Bear: "My chair is smaller~"
Baby Bear: "My chair is smaller~"
Whose is this medium chair?
The medium chair belongs to the middle bear.
segs: The medium chair belongs to the middle bear.

lines.en: It's Mama Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
segs: It's Mama Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.

lines.en: Papa Bear: "My chair is bigger~"
Baby Bear: "My chair is smaller~"
Baby Bear: "Waaah, my chair is broken!"

lines.text: 엄마 곰이 아기 곰을 꼭 안아 주었어요.
lines.en: Mama Bear gave Baby Bear a big, tight hug.
segs: Mama Bear gave Baby Bear a big, tight hug.

lines.en: But then they heard a snoring sound upstairs.
segs: But then they heard a snoring sound upstairs.

lines.text: 아기 곰이 살금살금 가 보니, 누가 자고 있어요!
lines.en: Baby Bear tiptoed over, and someone was sleeping there!
segs: Baby Bear tiptoed over, and someone was sleeping there!

lines.en: Tap the blanket.
Tap the blanket with Baby Bear!
segs: Tap the blanket with Baby Bear!

lines.text: 골디락스와 곰 세 마리 눈이 딱 마주쳤어요!
lines.en: Goldilocks and the three bears looked straight at each other!
segs: Goldilocks and the three bears looked straight at each other!

lines.en: She tried to climb out the window, but her skirt got caught!
segs: She tried to climb out the window, but her skirt got caught!

lines.en: Goldilocks turned around and said, "I'm sorry."
Goldilocks: "I'm sorry I came in without asking."
segs: I'm sorry I came in without asking.

lines.text: 아빠 곰: "괜찮아. 다음엔 똑똑 하고 기다려 줘."
lines.en: Papa Bear: "It's okay. Next time, knock and wait for us."
segs: It's okay. Next time, knock and wait for us.

lines.en: Goldilocks: "Shall we fix Baby Bear's chair together?"
segs: Shall we fix Baby Bear's chair together?

lines.en: Tap, tap to hammer and fix it!
segs: Tap, tap to hammer and fix it!

lines.en: Tap the chair! Bang, bang.
Ta-da! The chair is all fixed.
segs: Ta-da! The chair is all fixed.

lines.en: Baby Bear: "Thank you! Let's be friends!"

lines.text: 엄마 곰이 새 죽을 끓였어요. 다 함께 먹어요!
lines.en: Mama Bear cooked fresh porridge. Let's all eat together!
segs: Mama Bear cooked fresh porridge. Let's all eat together!

lines.text: 가장 작은 그릇부터 차례대로 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: Tap the bowls in order, starting with the smallest.
segs: Tap the bowls in order, starting with the smallest.

lines.en: Which is the smallest bowl?
Next is the medium bowl!
Last is the biggest bowl!
Find the big bowl.
Find the medium bowl.
Find the small bowl.
The big bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
segs: The big bowl is sparkling! Tap it.

lines.en: The medium bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
segs: The medium bowl is sparkling! Tap it.

lines.en: The small bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
segs: The small bowl is sparkling! Tap it.

lines.en: "I'm next~"

lines.text: 작은 그릇, 중간 그릇, 큰 그릇! 차례대로 담았어요.
lines.en: Small bowl, medium bowl, big bowl! All filled in order.
segs: Small bowl, medium bowl, big bowl! All filled in order.

lines.text: 골디락스 그릇도 하나 더! 다 함께 냠냠.
lines.en: One more bowl for Goldilocks! Yum, yum, all together.
segs: One more bowl for Goldilocks! Yum, yum, all together.

lines.text: 골디락스와 곰 가족은 사이좋은 친구가 되었답니다.
lines.en: Goldilocks and the bear family became good friends.
segs: Goldilocks and the bear family became good friends.

cut_hot: Goldilocks took a spoonful of the hot porridge.
cut_cold: Goldilocks ate the icy cold porridge.
cut_crack: The little chair breaks with a crack.
cut_eyes: Goldilocks woke up and met the eyes of the three bears.
There is a stranger in Baby Bear's bed.
cut_skirt: Oh no, my skirt is stuck!
Her skirt got caught as she tried to climb out the window.

ui.\"미안해요\" 하면 다시 친구가 될 수 있어요!: Say "I'm sorry" and you can be friends again!
ui.아빠 곰 엄마 곰 애기 곰: Papa bear, mama bear, baby bear
ui.아빠 곰은 뚱뚱해: Papa bear is big and round
